title: Insurance Claim Repairs Production Planning Table — Customer-Pay Stage Days
content:
Customer-pay stage days in the planned repair days of an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order follow the signed customer-pay addition consents of the repair order, by their labor hours taken together against the addition scope of **8.0 hours**.

| Signed customer-pay addition consents on the repair order | Their labor hours together | Stage days added |
|---|---|---|
| at least one | more than 8.0 | 2 (large-addition days) |
| at least one | 8.0 or fewer | 1 (small-addition days) |
| none | — | none |

**Clause.** When there is at least one signed customer-pay addition consent and their labor hours together are more than the addition scope hours of 8.0, the large-addition days of 2 are added; when there is at least one and their labor hours together are no more than 8.0, the small-addition days of 1 are added; with none, nothing is added.

### Hypothetical repair orders

| Signed consents and their hours | Total | Stage days |
|---|---|---|
| one consent, 3.0 hours | 3.0 | 1 |
| two consents, 5.0 and 3.0 hours | 8.0 | 1 |
| two consents, 5.0 and 3.5 hours | 8.5 | 2 |
| one part-upgrade consent with 0.0 labor hours | 0.0 | 1 |
| consents issued but none signed | — | none |

Only signed consents count; a consent still awaiting the customer, or one revoked, is not among them.
